postings.title: Category Manager
postings.description:
Buyagift and Red Letter Days are the UK’s leading gift experience provider. We’re all about turning special moments into extra-special memories. With a gifting range of 4000+ experiences from spa days and skydives to gourmet treats and once-in-a-lifetime adventures, we make it easy to give the gift of wow. 🎁
 
As part of the Moonpig Group, we’re proud to share that our vision is to become the most trusted platform in the UK gift experience market. Our mission is to spread happiness through thoughtful, joy-filled experiences. People are at the heart of everything we do. Since joining the Moonpig Group in 2022, we’ve been powered by strong values, bold ideas and a shared passion for making a real difference. Here, you’ll have the chance to shape the kind of experiences people never forget – and help us build connections that truly matter.
 


Category Manager | 📍London – Hybrid, 2 days per week in the office | 💰Competitive Salary + Benefits
 
About the Role

The opportunity
Own the strategy and performance of your experience categories across Buyagift and Red Letter Days, part of Moonpig Group. Shape a compelling range, grow sales and margin, and build partnerships that give customers more reasons to choose us.

Commercial ownership
You’ll define category plans and turn customer insight, market trends and commercial data into clear priorities for range and partner growth. You’ll balance hands-on trading with longer-term opportunities, testing new experiences, formats and price points.

Your team
You’ll report to the Head of Partner Growth and line-manage one Account Manager supporting your categories. You’ll own overall category results, set their priorities and targets, and take responsibility for their delivery and development. Working across Partner Acquisition, Marketing, Product and Trading, you’ll turn category plans into results. 


Key Responsibilities
Category Strategy and Growth

- Define and own category strategy, setting clear sales, margin, range and partner growth goals and prioritising opportunities using customer demand and commercial potential.

- Identify supply gaps and opportunities across selection, regional coverage and price points. Test new products and formats, measure results and scale what works.

- Agree acquisition priorities and partner requirements with Partner Acquisition, focusing recruitment on opportunities that strengthen the category proposition.

Partner Management and Negotiation

- Build trusted relationships with established and emerging partners, using regular business reviews to agree joint growth plans and address performance gaps.

- Negotiate pricing, commission and exclusivity terms that balance customer value, margin and sustainable partner growth.

- Work with partners to launch distinctive experiences and propositions that differentiate our offer.

Trading and Range Performance

- Lead seasonal planning, launches and campaigns across key moments such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day and Christmas, working with Marketing, Product and Trading.

- Use Excel and commercial reports to analyse sales, margin, conversion and customer satisfaction; understand performance gaps and take corrective action.

- Improve product content and merchandising with relevant teams, balancing immediate trading opportunities with longer-term innovation.

Leadership and Collaboration

- Set the Account Manager’s objectives and targets in line with category plans.

- Review their contribution to category results and agree corrective actions where needed, retaining accountability for overall performance.

- Agree account ownership and decision-making responsibilities.

- Hold regular one-to-ones and performance reviews, give specific feedback and maintain an individual development plan, coaching commercial analysis, partner management and negotiation.

- Align priorities, owners and deadlines across teams.

- Give clear updates on results and risks, resolve blockers and escalate with recommendations when support is needed.

- Champion commercial thinking, creativity and pace across Partner Growth; deputise for the Head of Partner Growth when required.

About You
- You’re commercially driven and curious, combining sound judgement with the ability to turn insight into action.

- You enjoy building partner relationships, negotiating value and taking ownership of results in a fast-moving environment.

- You may already manage people or be ready to step up, having coached colleagues or led shared work.

- You’ll balance your own commercial responsibilities with developing the Account Manager’s confidence, capability and delivery.

- The role also offers opportunities to broaden your commercial leadership and explore development across Moonpig Group.

Essential Skills and Experience
- A track record in category management, buying or commercial partnerships, with evidence of delivering sales or margin growth.

- Ability to translate customer insight and commercial analysis into clear range, partner and growth priorities.

- Strong negotiation, relationship-building and influencing skills across internal and external stakeholders.

- Confidence using Excel and reporting tools to investigate performance, evaluate opportunities and recommend action.

- Strong prioritisation and follow-through, with the ability to deliver at pace as trading conditions change.

- Experience managing people or evidence of coaching, mentoring or leading shared initiatives, with readiness to take responsibility for another person’s targets and development.

Desirable Skills and Experience
- Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, experiences, gifting, travel, hospitality or leisure.

- Experience in a high-growth company or established consumer brand with demanding commercial targets and high execution standards.

- Experience developing differentiated ranges, exclusive propositions or joint partner growth plans.

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Screen – 45–60 minutes.
Stage 3: Final Interview – 60 minutes with the Hiring Manager and a senior stakeholder, including a task presentation.

Creative Manager |📍London – Hybrid (1-2 days in office) | 💰Competitive Salary + Benefits | 6 Month Fixed-Term Contract 
About the Role
As Creative Manager, you will lead the creative expression of the Moonpig brand across campaigns and customer touchpoints. You will combine clear creative direction with hands-on design and production, turning brand and commercial priorities into distinctive, effective work. Over this six-month fixed-term contract, you will deliver live work while strengthening motion, using AI thoughtfully, and leaving the team with reusable tools, skills and ways of working.
You will work closely with Brand & Campaigns, CRM, Performance, Social, Product Marketing and Trading to deliver stronger ideas, consistent brand standards and high-quality assets at pace.
This is a 6-month fixed-term contract position. We are looking for someone to start ASAP.


Key Responsibilities
- Lead campaign concepts from brief to final execution, translating customer insight and commercial priorities into clear creative ideas, visual storytelling and connected asset systems.

- Own creative quality and brand consistency across campaigns, CRM, paid and organic social, onsite, app, partnerships and other relevant channels. Build practical guidelines and give clear, constructive feedback.

- Stay hands-on in design and production, present creative work with a clear rationale, and develop designers and creative partners through regular reviews and coaching.

- Develop and produce motion graphics, animation and short-form video, taking work from storyboards and animatics through editing, compositing, sound and final delivery.

- Create engaging, channel-appropriate motion for brand and performance activity, including product storytelling, animated typography, social video and campaign adaptations.

- Build reusable motion templates and principles that improve consistency and speed, maintaining quality across aspect ratios, durations, captions and platform specifications.

- Use AI across briefing, idea development, visual exploration, storyboarding, image creation and editing. Translate briefs into clear prompts and reference inputs, iterate deliberately, and judge when AI adds value or traditional craft is the better choice.

- Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for campaign assets, channel adaptations and creative test variants. Use human art direction and professional design tools to refine outputs into accurate, polished and editable final work.

- Apply AI to motion and video, including animatics, image-to-video exploration, generative video and production assistance. Judge continuity, pacing and visual consistency, combining generated material with conventional animation, editing and compositing.

- Test approved tools on live briefs, comparing quality, time, cost and rework with existing methods. Document useful prompts, reference inputs and repeatable workflows, and coach the team to use them confidently.

- Keep human review and approval in every workflow. Check brand fit, product and factual accuracy, accessibility, representation and visual artefacts, and follow company requirements for confidentiality, data handling, consent, copyright and commercial usage rights.

- Partner with studio coordination on scope, feasibility, creative resource needs and delivery milestones. Own the creative response, reviews and quality standards, with day-to-day intake, scheduling and request tracking managed through the studio workflow.

- Work with marketing owners early in planning to agree the audience, creative objective, deliverables and approval points. Challenge unclear briefs and resolve competing feedback constructively.

- Use audience insight and creative performance data to shape testing and improve work, assessing quality, production time and rework alongside relevant brand, engagement and conversion measures.

- Over six months, deliver distinctive and consistent creative for agreed campaigns and trading priorities, leave practical brand and motion guidance, reusable templates, tested AI workflows and a clear handover of editable files, prompts, reference inputs, workflow guidance and learnings.

About You
- You have a strong portfolio of distinctive brand and campaign work across channels, showing both creative leadership and your own hands-on contribution.

- You bring strong design craft across typography, composition, visual identity and storytelling, with the ability to turn a strategic brief into a coherent creative idea.

- You have practical motion design, animation and video-editing skills, including storyboarding, pacing, transitions, footage and graphics, and delivering finished assets to specification.

- You have hands-on experience with generative AI and language-model tools for creative ideation, visual development and production, with examples of work you have directed and refined beyond the first output.

- You can use structured briefs and visual references, assess alternative outputs, maintain brand consistency and resolve errors or unwanted artefacts through strong prompting and iterative art direction.

- You have sound judgement about AI limitations, responsible use and commercial rights, and can explain what was generated, what you changed, how you checked it and whether the approach improved the work.

- You are confident directing and developing other creatives, presenting work to stakeholders and balancing creative ambition with commercial priorities and deadlines.

- You are proficient in professional design, motion and editing software and can combine AI outputs with established tools to deliver editable working files. Demonstrated capability matters more than experience with one specific AI platform.

- Experience with consumer or ecommerce brands, seasonal and high-volume campaign delivery, performance creative testing, reusable design and motion systems, or introducing AI workflows to a creative team would be helpful, but is not essential.

- For your portfolio, include campaign design and motion or video examples, highlight your personal contribution, and explain the brief, tools, prompts or reference inputs, iterations, craft, checks and any evidenced effect on quality or delivery time for AI-enabled work. Only share work you have permission to disclose; anonymised examples are welcome.

Buyagift and Red Letter Days are the UK’s leading gift experience provider. We’re all about turning special moments into extra-special memories. With a gifting range of 4000+ experiences from spa days and skydives to gourmet treats and once-in-a-lifetime adventures, we make it easy to give the gift of wow. 🎁
 
As part of the Moonpig Group, we’re proud to share that our vision is to become the most trusted platform in the UK gift experience market. Our mission is to spread happiness through thoughtful, joy-filled experiences. People are at the heart of everything we do. Since joining the Moonpig Group in 2022, we’ve been powered by strong values, bold ideas and a shared passion for making a real difference. Here, you’ll have the chance to shape the kind of experiences people never forget – and help us build connections that truly matter.
 


Senior Category Manager | 📍London – Hybrid (2 days in office) | 💰Competitive Salary + Benefits
About the Role
The opportunity
Own the strategy and performance of your experience categories across Buyagift and Red Letter Days, part of Moonpig Group. Shape an exciting range of experiences, grow sales and margin, and build partnerships that give customers more reasons to choose us.
Commercial ownership
You'll turn customer insight, market trends and commercial data into clear category plans that drive growth. Balancing day-to-day trading with longer-term opportunities, you'll explore new experiences, formats and price points while improving the performance of our existing range.
Your team
Reporting to the Head of Partner Growth, you'll lead a team of three direct reports supporting your categories. You'll set clear priorities and targets, take ownership of category results and support your team's development through regular feedback and coaching.
You'll also work closely with Partner Acquisition, Marketing, Product and Trading to turn category plans into results.


Key Responsibilities
Category Strategy and Growth

- 

Define and own category strategies, setting clear sales, margin, range and partner growth goals based on customer demand, market trends and commercial opportunities.

- 

Identify gaps in our experience range, regional coverage and price points. Test new products and formats, measure results and build on what works.

- 

Work with Partner Acquisition to agree recruitment priorities and partner requirements, helping us attract partners that strengthen our category offering.

Partner Management and Negotiation

- 

Build trusted relationships with new and existing partners, understanding their goals and agreeing joint growth plans through regular business reviews.

- 

Negotiate pricing, commission and exclusivity agreements that balance customer value, commercial performance and sustainable partner growth.

- 

Collaborate with partners to develop and launch distinctive experiences that help our brands stand out.

Trading and Range Performance

- 

Lead seasonal planning, launches and campaigns around key gifting moments, including Valentine's Day, Mother's Day and Christmas, working closely with Marketing, Product and Trading.

- 

Use Excel and commercial reporting tools to analyse sales, margin, conversion and customer satisfaction, identify performance gaps and take action.

- 

Work with relevant teams to improve product content and merchandising, balancing immediate trading opportunities with longer-term innovation.

Leadership and Collaboration

- 

Set clear objectives and targets for your three direct reports, aligned with category sales, margin and partner growth plans. Review individual and team performance, agree actions where needed and retain accountability for overall category results.

- 

Agree account ownership, priorities and decision-making responsibilities across the team, giving each person the confidence and autonomy to deliver.

- 

Hold regular one-to-ones and performance reviews, providing constructive feedback and coaching to develop your team's commercial analysis, partner management and negotiation skills.

- 

Align priorities, responsibilities and deadlines across teams. Share clear updates on results and risks, resolve challenges and escalate issues with recommendations when support is needed.

- 

Champion commercial thinking, creativity and high standards across Buying, and deputise for the Head of Partner Growth when required.

About You
You're commercially minded, curious and confident turning insight into action. You enjoy building strong partner relationships, negotiating value and finding opportunities to grow a category.

You'll bring a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on delivery, with the ability to adapt and make sound decisions in a fast-moving environment.

You'll enjoy leading and developing a team, setting clear expectations and helping others grow their skills and confidence while taking ownership of commercial results.

The role also offers opportunities to build your commercial leadership skills, broaden your experience and explore career development across Moonpig Group.

Essential Skills and Experience
- 

Proven experience in category management, buying or commercial partnerships, with a track record of delivering sales or margin growth.

- 

Ability to turn customer insights, market trends and commercial analysis into clear range, partner and growth priorities.

- 

Strong negotiation, relationship-building and influencing skills, with experience working across internal teams and external partners.

- 

Confidence using Excel and reporting tools to investigate performance, assess opportunities and make informed commercial decisions.

- 

Strong prioritisation and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver plans and adapt to changing trading conditions.

- 

Experience managing people, coaching colleagues or leading shared initiatives, with the ability to take responsibility for team performance, delivery and development.

Desirable Skills and Experience
- 

Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, experiences, gifting, travel, hospitality or leisure.

- 

Experience in a high-growth business or established consumer brand with ambitious commercial targets.

- 

Experience developing distinctive ranges, exclusive experiences or joint partner growth plans.

We know great people come from different backgrounds, so don't worry if you don't tick every box. We're interested in your commercial judgement, the impact you've made and your potential to grow.

Interview Process
Stage 1: TA Screen – 30 minutes.

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Screen – 45–60 minutes.

Stage 3: Final Interview – 60 minutes with the Hiring Manager and a senior stakeholder, including a task presentation.

Our process may vary depending on role and availability. We keep candidates informed of any changes.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in empowering our team to do their best work. Enjoy:
 💸 Competitive Pay & Bonuses: Plus generous pension plans, staff discounts, and share schemes.
 💆🏾‍♀️ Wellbeing First: Private healthcare (UK), dental, life insurance and mental health support
 🏖️ Flexible Working & Time Off: Generous holidays, hybrid working (unless specified otherwise, 2 days a week in the office), and opportunities for international working.
 📈 Career Growth: Learning allowances, coaching, and development programs.
 🤝 Recognition & Giving Back: Regular awards, charity support, length of service awards, and volunteering days.
 
Want to see more? 
Check out our Linked In pages below:
Buyagift
Red Letter Days
Moonpig Group
 
Our Ways of Working:
We trust our colleagues to do what’s right and offer flexibility to support a balance between work and life. At the same time, face-to-face office time is an important and expected part of working at Moonpig Group. We believe regular in-person working supports collaboration, alignment, and effective decision-making. Candidates will have regular and ongoing time working from the office as part of their role, which will be discussed during the recruitment process.
 
Moonpig Group's Commitment to Equality, Diversity, and Inclusivity:
At Moonpig Group, we’re all about creating a workplace where everyone feels they truly belong. We celebrate what makes each of us unique, whether that’s our background, how we work best, or what matters most to us.
 
From working parents who need flexible hours to neurodiverse colleagues with specific working styles, we’re here to support our people in ways that work for them. Because when you feel valued and included, you can thrive, and so can we.
 
We’re proud to have a number of employee-led groups driving this forward, including our LGBTQ+, Gender Balance, Neurodiversity and EMBRACE (Educating Myself for Better Racial Awareness and Cultural Enrichment) communities, plus our Group-wide EDI committee. These teams help make sure every voice is heard and every idea has a place.
